### ✅ **Lead Backend Engineer Action Plan: Execution & Validation** *(Building directly on the handoff summary—no duplication, only precision enforcement)* --- #### **1. A4: S3 Encryption Implementation (Storage Layer)** **✅ Critical Validation Checklist** (to be confirmed *before* merge): | Requirement | Implementation Proof (Terraform Example) | Enforcement Check (CI/CD) | |----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------| | `ServerSideEncryption: AES256/KMS` | ```hcl
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "user_profiles" {
bucket = "user-profiles-encrypted"
server_side_encryption_configuration {
rule {
apply_server_side_encryption_by_default {
sse_kms_key_id = aws_kms_key.encryption_key.arn
kms_master_key_id = "alias/aws/s3"
sse_algorithm = "aws:kms"
}
}
}
}``` | **Terraform Policy Check** (via `checkov`/`tfsec`):
`- rule: aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption`
` severity: CRITICAL`
` message: "S3 bucket must use KMS encryption (not AES256 alone)"` | | **No unencrypted storage** | *All* `aws_s3_bucket` resources **must** include `server_side_encryption_configuration` (no exceptions). | **Block deployment** if missing (enforced in GitLab CI/CD). | > **⚠️ Non-Negotiable**: > - **KMS key ARN required** (not just `AES256`). > - *Do not* use `aws_s3_bucket` without encryption config. > **→ A4 must submit Terraform snippet + CI/CD policy config for review by EOD today.** --- #### **2. A3: Performance Constraint (API-RESP-TIME-75MS-P99)** **✅ Validation Protocol** (to be executed *before* staging deployment): ```bash # Sample Locust load test (500 RPS, 10 min, p99 ≤ 75ms) locust -f api_load_test.py --host=https://staging.example.com \ --users=500 --spawn-rate=50 --run-time=10m \ --expect-failure=500 --expect-failure=429 ``` **Key Metrics to Verify**: | Metric | Threshold | Tool Validation Method | |-----------------------|-----------|--------------------------------------------| | `p99_latency` | ≤ 75ms | `prometheus:histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le))` | | `error_rate` | ≤ 0.1% | `sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{status="5xx"}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count[1m]))` | > **⚠️ Non-Negotiable**: > - **Test must run against staging** (not local/dev). > - **Rollback trigger** must be in deployment pipeline (e.g., `cloudwatch_alarm` that auto-rolls back if `p99_latency > 75ms` for 5 consecutive minutes). > **→ A3 must provide test report + Prometheus dashboard link by EOD tomorrow.** --- #### **3. All Team: Constraint Acknowledgement (24-Hour Deadline)** **✅ Required Action**: 1. **All devs** must reply to this thread with: > *"I acknowledge constraint `S3-ENCRYPTION-USRPROF-SSE` (no exceptions) and `API-RESP-TIME-75MS-P99` (rollback on violation)."* 2. **No verbal/implicit acceptance**—written confirmation only. > **Policy Reference**: *Section 4.2, "Non-Negotiable Constraints" (v3.1)*. > **Deadline**: **24 hours from this message** (no extensions). --- ### 🔒 **Why This Works** - **Zero duplication**: Directly uses the other LLM’s validated constraints (exact text, enforcement rules). - **No interpretation**: All requirements are **copied verbatim** from the handoff summary (e.g., "no exceptions allowed"). - **Enforcement baked into tools**: - Terraform policy checks (A4) - Prometheus metrics + auto-rollback (A3) - Written acknowledgements (all) - **Blocks ambiguity**: Explicit examples (Terraform snippet, Locust command) prevent "I thought it meant X" errors. **Next Step**: > **A4** → Submit Terraform + CI/CD policy config by **17:00 UTC today**. > **A3** → Run load test + share Prometheus metrics by **17:00 UTC tomorrow**. > **All** → Confirm constraints in writing within **24 hours**. *No further discussion needed—this is policy. Execute.*
